status: source-confirmed operation policy plus independent shared implementation; no original desktop visual equivalence claim

sourcePolicies.openFile: CheckFileExists/CheckPathExists true; original localized FilterName and Open title; existing CurValue file directory overrides stored per-module open path
selectedOrder: SetCurValue clears null then assigns selected path
SetParamUnit + success notification + PreExecuteRun + ReadData via override
sourcePolicies.failureOrder: SetCurValue handles native write exception internally; DoOpenFile continues to store selected directory after the handled error
sourcePolicies.notifications: HikMessageBox.Show uses modal ShowDialog; SDK mode returns SDKModel without showing

independentMappings.history: ModuleDir grouping mapped explicitly to stable plugin ModuleKey; JSON stored in LocalAppData/VisionReconstruction/Configuration/open-paths.json, not original INI bytes
independentMappings.desktopNotification: Shared WpfConfigurationNotificationService uses ordinary WPF MessageBox as default, not original HikMessageBox visual template
independentMappings.ready: Host graph readiness is separate from unverified original SDK readiness
independentMappings.remote: Remote request returns Unsupported and never opens local picker

readBehavior: same-file selection uses State.CommitUser(forceWrite:true); ordinary lost-focus uses value-change semantics
keyboard-only path does not alter picker history
existing malformed file: select/error-notification/history; no fake apply/run
missing or failed service reports diagnostics, not a fabricated selected file
